capabilities: Group multiple images into one cluster in a note
Adjust image size, gap, radius, shadow and border
Blur images and block opening them with the hidden option
Limit display to three rows until expanded
Edit saved options manually in the imgs block
extras: The README is bilingual (Chinese and English) and references an animation showing the interactions; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian renders embedded images as separate blocks, so notes with many images look scattered and disorganized.
summary: Image grouping plugin that arranges multiple images in a note into a styled, interactive cluster inside an imgs code block.
